Name: Quick Agenda
Author: BadNetCode
Description:
See upcoming events with a keypress (default Q).
Displays a transparent list with birthdays, festivals, quest due dates, and bookseller days.

Includes options to:
[list]
[*]open silently
[*]set custom key binding
[*]hide birthdays
[*]hide festivals
[*]hide bookseller
[*]hide help wanted quests (automatically hidden if you use QuestDelay)
[*]hide special orders
[*]change opacity (0%-100%
[*]change text size (50%-200% scaling)
[/list]
I highly recommend installing the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

Manifest.Name: Quick Agenda
Manifest.Description: Add agenda overlay that can be toggled
